run_generate_changelog: run the script with a previous release tag to generate a per-language changelog
review_Language_class: review the Language class that stores a name and pathspec list for each protobuf language
refactor_Language_class: refactor the Language class to support additional metadata fields beyond name and pathspec
summarize_languages_list: summarize the languages list that defines pathspecs for C++, Java, Python, JS, PHP, Ruby, Csharp, and Objective C
test_generate_changelog: test the script by passing a git tag to verify changelog output for each language
